The diagram shows a circuit.
Which statement correctly describes this circuit?
A
A magnetising coil is in series with a fuse.
B
A transformer is in series with a fuse.
C
A magnetising coil is in series with a resistor.
D
A transformer is in series with a resistor.

options.label: A
options.text: A magnetising coil is in series with a fuse.

options.label: B
options.text: A transformer is in series with a fuse.

options.label: C
options.text: A magnetising coil is in series with a resistor.

options.label: D
options.text: A transformer is in series with a resistor.
